editorial:
Imagine you are a guy who spent years trying to be a better person, only to find out your brother was murdered. That is where you start with this flick. You follow a man who is a reformed sociopath traveling to a quiet, remote island to handle his brother's affairs. The vibe starts off slow and mysterious, but it quickly turns into a nightmare when a group of scary mercenaries takes over the place. You get to see the main character flip a switch from a calm man back into a deadly killing machine, and it is a blast to watch him hunt down the people who ruined his family.

The action is the best part here, with plenty of fight scenes that keep you on the edge of your seat. While the plot is a bit predictable, the lead actor does a great job showing the struggle between his old self and his new self. If you love movies where one guy takes on an entire army, you will love this.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, you see the main character use his sociopathic skills to outsmart and kill the mercenary leader. He discovers the full truth about why his brother was targeted and uses that anger to fuel his final attack. After a brutal fight, he wipes out the remaining bad guys and saves the survivors. He finds peace knowing his brother is avenged, though he accepts that the darkness inside him will always be there.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves one-man-army action movies and revenge stories.
